energyEquipment.howSupportPlant: Provides steam to different systems that are used for cleaning, cooking, temperature maintenance
energyEquipment.adverseEffects:
Inconsistent heat in tanks makes chocolate grainy and causes quality issues.
lack of steam for cleaning can hold up the entire process
energyEquipment.equipmentFinancialStatus: 15 years old. not ready to replace
energyEquipment.describeOutputOfSystem:
Steam is 400F, 200 psi
Some is used at that pressure and some uses a PRV to reduce pressure to 100psi where more is used

Steam leaks are prevalent. That and poor insulation on lines and tanks lead to variations in chocolate quality.
energyEquipment.describeServicingNeeds:
System is critical - if steam goes down, the plant goes down.
Maintenance is about what is expected. Service parts are in stock and labor is available.
energyEquipment.describeLaborRequirements: The steam system has one full time employee present at all times.
energyEquipment.describeWasteStreams:
blowdown is is controlled based on conductivity
Water in system is treated and water costs could be better estimated taking that into account.
energyEquipment.describeWaterInputDischarge: Steam uses a lot of water, only 75% of condensate is returned - looking into this as an efficiency project
energyEquipment.describeRegulations: Boiler has environmental regs, no expected impact, no major problems.
energyEquipment.describeSafetyConcerns: some downsteam systems have poor insulation.  will explore more elsewhere
energyEquipment.financialMetricsUsed: $ per klb of steam is tracked. it includes fuel, water, and labor costs

energyEquipment.howSupportPlant: Lighting is critical. Manual inspections require good lighting. Tours require good lighting
energyEquipment.adverseEffects: Inspections take a long time due to low light. Employee bring in headlamps.
energyEquipment.describeOutputOfSystem: Light is really dim - current lights produce dark corners and make some QA difficult.
energyEquipment.describeServicingNeeds: Have to change a lot of bulbs. some are really high up
energyEquipment.describeSystemMaterials: Bulbs. Will add details in KPI page.

energyEquipment.notes: 200 hp rotary screw from 1999- 26 yrs old
energyEquipment.howSupportPlant:
Several operations in cleaning and packaging require air
Several pneumatic pumps in areas with powder
energyEquipment.adverseEffects: Improved reliability, operate faster if end of lines are at higher pressure. Several areas shutdown if no air
energyEquipment.equipmentFinancialStatus: It is end of life, but haven't yet replaced
energyEquipment.describeOutputOfSystem: between leaks and reliability issues, it only barely meets needs
energyEquipment.describeServicingNeeds:
A LOT
3rd party labor required regularly in addition to on-site labor

processEquipment.notes: Heat lost down lines via steam leaks
processEquipment.whatIsTheOutput: heat for various places in plant.  cleaning
processEquipment.financialStatusOfEquipment: not planning major overhauls.  improving insulation and leaks could get approval
processEquipment.describeOutputQualityMeasurement: Heat loss in lines and tanks have lead to quality concerns
processEquipment.describeMaintenanceNeeds: Currently do not do enough steam leak / trap surveys. Often only fix immediately if it a safety concern. Do a steam leak repair push every few years.
processEquipment.describeWorkplaceEnvironment: can make areas of site hot/muggy and uncomfortable

processEquipment.notes:
Big tank that keeps chocolate warm before barring via steam.
Currently uninsulated - causing problems with quality of bars
processEquipment.whatIsTheOutput: Liquid chocolate for putting into bar molds. This is a key step in the final product.
processEquipment.describeOutputQualityMeasurement: Quality - has noticed issues due to chocolate being cooler than it should be
processEquipment.describeSafetyConcerns: Hot tank has been known to cause burns
processEquipment.describeWorkplaceEnvironment: Hot tank makes employees uncomfortable. There have been complaints.

processEquipment.notes:
Machines pour chocolate in molds and wrap the bars
Humans inspect bars before and after wrapping
Quality issues often missed before wrapping due to lighting issues
processEquipment.whatIsTheOutput: Wrapped chocolate bars. This is the final product.
processEquipment.howDoesTheProcessWork: hot tank supplies melted chocolate into molds. line cools then demolds, visual inspection, machine wraps, visual inspection
processEquipment.describeOutputRate:
could always be better.
poor lighting makes QA slow
processEquipment.describeOutputQualityMeasurement: Quality issues from poor heating in tank
processEquipment.describeWasteStreams:
bars that don't meet QA standards are waste + packaging waste. no opportunities to sell or reuse.
Disposal via normal waste, no extra disposal costs.
